# Synthetic focus tree used to exercise the checks.
# Every defect below is deliberate; the expected findings are listed in
# tests/test_checks.py. This file contains no game data.

focus_tree = {
	id = testland_focus
	country = {
		factor = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			tag = TST
		}
	}
	default = no

	focus = {
		id = TST_rearmament
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_army_doctrines
		x = 4
		y = 0
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			army_experience = 5
		}
	}

	# Two paths that should exclude each other, but only one side declares it.
	focus = {
		id = TST_land_doctrine
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_army_tanks
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_rearmament }
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = TST_naval_doctrine }
		x = 2
		y = 1
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			army_experience = 10
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = TST_naval_doctrine
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_navy_battleship
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_rearmament }
		x = 6
		y = 1
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			navy_experience = 10
		}
	}

	# Requires both halves of an exclusive pair, so it can never be taken.
	focus = {
		id = TST_combined_arms
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_land_doctrine }
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_naval_doctrine }
		x = 4
		y = 2
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			add_political_power = 50
		}
	}

	# Points at a focus that does not exist anywhere.
	focus = {
		id = TST_expeditionary_force
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_colonial_office }
		x = 8
		y = 2
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			add_manpower = 1000
		}
	}

	# Completing this does nothing.
	focus = {
		id = TST_war_economy
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_rearmament }
		x = 10
		y = 1
		cost = 10
	}

	# Gated but never bypasses, and collides with TST_war_economy on the grid.
	focus = {
		id = TST_total_mobilisation
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_war_economy }
		available = {
			has_war = yes
		}
		x = 10
		y = 1
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			add_ideas = idea_total_mobilisation
		}
	}

	# A prerequisite loop: neither can ever be taken.
	focus = {
		id = TST_first_congress
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_second_congress }
		x = 14
		y = 1
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			add_political_power = 10
		}
	}

	focus = {
		id = TST_second_congress
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_first_congress }
		x = 14
		y = 2
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			add_political_power = 10
		}
	}

	# Positioned relative to a focus that does not exist.
	focus = {
		id = TST_home_defence
		prerequisite = { focus = TST_rearmament }
		relative_position_id = TST_coastal_command
		x = 1
		y = 1
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			add_ideas = idea_home_defence
		}
	}

	# Duplicate of the entry focus above.
	focus = {
		id = TST_rearmament
		x = 16
		y = 0
		cost = 10
		completion_reward = {
			army_experience = 5
		}
	}
}
